category.name: CRM, support and marketing
category.description: Contacts, deals, support tickets and email campaigns.

entries.name: Attio API
entries.free_tier: check pricing (free trial available; no permanent free tier confirmed)
entries.desc_en: Search, create, and update records, lists, and notes in an Attio CRM workspace via REST API or official MCP.
entries.notes: Official MCP at mcp.attio.com/mcp uses OAuth login (no API key needed); read ops auto-approved, write ops require user confirmation in the MCP client.

entries.name: HubSpot API
entries.free_tier: free CRM account with limited-scope API access; many endpoints require a paid Hub tier (see APIs-by-tier docs)
entries.desc_en: Create/update CRM contacts, deals, companies, and engagements, or send marketing emails, via REST API or remote MCP.
entries.notes: Remote MCP server at mcp.hubspot.com requires account admin authorization first (OAuth2); some API endpoints gated by subscription tier.

entries.name: Intercom API
entries.free_tier: free development workspace for building/testing; production use requires a paid Intercom plan
entries.desc_en: Manage conversations, contacts, companies, and Help Center articles via REST API or Intercom's official remote MCP server.
entries.notes: Official MCP has region-specific endpoints: US at mcp.intercom.com/mcp, EU at mcp.eu.intercom.com/mcp; supports OAuth or bearer token auth.

entries.name: Klaviyo API
entries.free_tier: free plan up to 250 contacts / 500 email sends per month
entries.desc_en: Manage email/SMS marketing profiles, lists, flows, and campaign analytics via Klaviyo's REST API or official MCP server.
entries.notes: Official remote MCP at mcp.klaviyo.com/mcp uses OAuth with dynamic client registration; a local MCP server option also exists. Private key scopes cannot be edited after creation.

entries.name: Mailchimp Marketing API
entries.auth_hint: Basic auth 'anystring:<api_key>' or Authorization: Bearer <token>; API key suffix encodes data center (e.g. -us6)
entries.free_tier: free plan up to 250 contacts / 500 emails per month (API accessible on free plan)
entries.desc_en: Manage email marketing audiences, campaigns, and automation via Mailchimp's Marketing REST API.
entries.notes: No official MCP server found; no widely-adopted community MCP identified. API base URL includes account-specific data-center subdomain.

entries.name: Pipedrive API
entries.auth_hint: api_token query param, or Authorization: Bearer <oauth_token>
entries.free_tier: no free tier; 14/30-day trial and free developer sandbox account for testing
entries.desc_en: Create and update deals, contacts (persons/organizations), and activities in a Pipedrive CRM pipeline via REST API.
entries.notes: No official or notably popular community MCP server found. Offers a free Sandbox account for development/testing separate from production pricing.

entries.name: Salesforce APIs
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (OAuth2 web-server / JWT bearer flow)
entries.free_tier: free Developer Edition org available via signup at developer.salesforce.com/signup
entries.desc_en: Read and write Salesforce CRM records (leads, opportunities, cases) programmatically via REST, GraphQL, or Bulk API.
entries.notes: Official salesforcecli/mcp server is scoped to developer/DevOps tooling (metadata deploy, Apex, LWC) against an authorized org, not a general end-user CRM-data MCP; requires local Salesforce CLI org authorization. Core data access is via REST/GraphQL/Bulk APIs with OAuth2.

entries.name: Zendesk API
entries.free_tier: free trial (14 days); no permanent free tier, paid Suite plans required for ongoing use
entries.desc_en: Create, update, and search support tickets, users, and Help Center articles via Zendesk's REST API.
entries.notes: No official Zendesk-maintained MCP server found as of research date; several community MCP servers exist. API tokens can impersonate any account user, including admins.
